stage1.impression: A clear cast cylinder with stacked lens voids and the spindle seen through it, sitting on a dark gloss disc in front of a light cove; the glass reads, but the voids' cores are saturated blue like inlaid paint, and the left wall is a blown white bar. The black record and its label read as mid-grey, so the base looks like a grey plate under a candle holder and not a collectible on vinyl.

blocking_9: The record label reads as black paper: region [340,770,420,800] lum_median between 40 and 75 and delta_e to #1E1E1E under 15 (now 126 and 33.1).
The vinyl reads as black gloss: LP foreground [60,980,300,1150] lum_median at or under 60 (now 78.5), with the object's reflection streaks kept.
Neither side wall of the cylinder clips: left wall [450,500,470,800] clip_pct under 10 (now 59.5), with a dark refracted edge on both sides (right [1270,520,1310,800] already 47).
The voids read as air, with silver rims and neutral to pale cores, not saturated blue: void [700,635,800,648] r_median at or above 40 (now 12.5).
The top face shows the voids below it through a calm reflection, not a busy pale-blue mirror with 1.2% clipped glints ([700,380,1100,440]).

changes.problem: The matte-black label outside the weight's footprint reads mid-grey because the 600 x 360 overhead floods it, and the same overhead, entering through the blue lamina, fills the void cores with saturated blue.

evidence.measured: label lum_median 125.8, RGB 131/125/119, delta_e2000 to #1E1E1E 33.1; void core [700,635,800,648] RGB median 12/74/112

changes.expected: Label outside the footprint drops to about lum 55-70 and reads as black paper; the caustic under the weight stays as the brightest part of the label; void cores lose some of their blue fill.

changes.problem: The left wall of the cylinder is a blown white bar, while the right wall has a dark refracted edge, so the solid looks lopsided and its left silhouette disappears.
changes.expected: The left wall keeps a bright line about 5-8 px wide but no longer clips across its full 20 px width; p95 stays near white so the edge still glints.

changes.problem: Only the right wall gets a dark refracted edge, so the left half of the body is flat grey and gives no sense of the 80 mm of solid acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 108, p5 62.8, vs right wall 47.4; x-profile across the body 128, 149, 141, 140, 138, 137, 130, 68: dark only at the right

change.to: matte black card #111111, 160 x 300 mm, at (-210, 60, 0 to 300), facing the object, outside the frame

changes.expected: A dark refracted band 20-40 px wide on the inner left wall, matching the right, so the cylinder is drawn by dark lines on both sides as clear glass is.

changes.problem: The glossy vinyl reflects the near-white cove and reads as mid-grey, not black record.
changes.expected: The cove near the horizon drops to about 195-210, still bright-field behind the glass; the vinyl drops to about 55-65 and reads as black, with the object's reflection streaks intact.

changes.problem: The card meant as a black flag is pale blue-white, and the top face mirrors it as a busy pale-blue sheet with clipped glints that hide the voids under it.
changes.expected: The top face becomes a darker mirror, about lum 85-115, through which the void columns read with depth; the lamina's pale blue shows at the edge band only.

changes.problem: The void rims carry only thin silver lines and their cores take the colour of whatever they mirror, so they read as blue inlays rather than trapped air.

change.setting: asset: white bounce card low front
change.to: matte white card #F2F2F2, 300 x 80 mm, at (0, -260, 0 to 80) lying 30 degrees back, below the frame, unlit except by the key

changes.expected: The voids' undersides mirror a neutral white by total internal reflection, so the cores go silver-grey with r_median above 40 and the blue stays at the rims only.

out_of_scope.request: Make the void cores less blue by changing the lamina tint or its absorption.
out_of_scope.why: Tint and optics are fixed by the measured transmission chart; the fix has to come from what the voids mirror (c1, c6).

out_of_scope.request: Shallow depth of field to soften the LP horizon.
out_of_scope.why: At 100 mm and 420 mm the depth of field at f/5.6 is about 5 mm, far less than the 80 mm object; any useful softening would blur the product.
